newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech says relations with Agrobanka hold.
newsitem.headline: Czech says relations with Agrobanka hold.

text.p: Ceska Sporitelna, the largest Czech savings bank, said on Monday its trading relationship with troubled Agrobanka remained unaffected despite a central bank move placing the bank under temporary forced administration.
"Ceska Sporitelna has, and is keeping with Agrobanka its current trading relations," a bank statement said.
"The management of Sporitelna confirms that the possibility exists for their further extension," the statement added.
The statement did not specify what trading relations the two banks had, but Sporitelna is a dominant player on the Czech money and debt markets and participates on the equity market.

Early Tuesday, the CNB said it placed the bank under temporary forced administration after it experienced liquidity problems arising from the failure of Kreditni Banka Plzen a.s. and the investigation of people in the Kreditni case who are also connected to Agrobanka.
Agrobanka is the fifth largest Czech bank, while Ceska Sporitelna is the largest savings bank.
